notable_absence.finding: Several boolean-style options (Index, Store, Include in \_all field, Include Term Vectors, Doc Values) are described only in terms of what selecting/clearing the checkbox does, with no page anywhere stating what the DEFAULT state of each checkbox is when a new child field is created - unlike quick-index-field-options.md's Searchable As row, which does state its own default ('The default value is the field's name'), this page's own Searchable As row instead defers to 'the value set in the Field field when you create a child field' rather than stating a literal default.

cross_component_finding: Direct, verbatim confirmation of the correspondence the round briefing asked about between this page and quick-index-field-options.md (the full mapping editor's child-field options vs. the Quick Editor's field options for the same product, same Search Service). The Dimension, Similarity Metric, and Optimized For (Vector Fields Only) rows are WORD-FOR-WORD IDENTICAL text blocks in both pages - not just similar, but character-for-character the same paragraph duplicated across two reference pages - and the Synonym Source (Text Fields Only) row is near-identical apart from which synonym-management sub-pages it links to (synonyms/create-synonym-collection-docs.md + add-synonym-source.md here, vs. the '-quick' variants of both on quick-index-field-options.md). This confirms both pages describe ONE underlying settable-options surface exposed through two different index-creation entry points (the full mapping editor vs. the Quick Editor shortcut, create-quick-index.md), exactly as the round briefing hypothesized - recorded here as a sharesOptionSetWith relation with a verbatim quote, upgrading the 7.2-era create-child-field.json record's earlier hedge ('neither page cross-references the other's option vocabulary... flagging as a watchlist candidate') to a confirmed finding now that the reference content has been split onto its own page and both tables are directly comparable.
